messages:
ana: Quick alert 0: staging CI failing on binary fetch step after we bumped base-image to webimage:v2.0.1. Blocking promo window at 11:00.

ci-bot: CI job 7821 failed - error downloading /opt/chrome/chrome-bin: checksum mismatch (expected abc123, got def456). See logs: https://ci.internal/7821/logs

luke: Wow checksum flip. Could be build output differences or the image registry truncated the layer. Did we pull from the same mirror?

meera: We used mirror eu-west-2 this morning. I also saw one image digest change in the registry replication logs. Reproducing locally now.

infra: Deploy-bot auto-paused promotions for this pipeline id. Manual approval required to continue. :no_entry:

ana: Repro steps I'm running locally:
```
docker pull registry.redwood/webimage:v2.0.1
sha256sum /var/lib/docker/overlay2/.../layer.tar
```
Local digest matches the registry digest but CI agent reports different checksum.

luke: Could be CI agent tar extraction differences (older tar version) or partial upload. If it's partial upload we'd see size discrepancy. Can we get the CI runner's docker engine logs?

ci-bot: runner logs attached: https://ci.internal/7821/runner-logs. Shows unexpected EOF during layer stream at 15:43:12 UTC.

meera: That points to transient network/read timeout during multipart upload to mirror. Two options: 1) pin pipeline to webimage:v1.23 (last known good) and proceed with manual promote, or 2) retry push/restore mirror and re-run CI which will delay the window.

release-manager: We need decision: hit the change window or delay. If we pin, add a release note called "pin(webimage): revert to v1.23 due to checksum mismatch on v2.0.1 mirror" and call out follow-up investigation.

ana: I can open PR to pin the manifest to v1.23 now. If approved we can spin a canary in us-west-2 and run a small smoke job to validate.

infra: Suggestion: start a quick canary with pinned image in us-west-2 while we also re-run the mirror sync for v2.0.1. That way we can keep momentum and still investigate.

luke: +1. If canary is green we do a manual promote and document in release notes. If canary flakes, pause and escalate to SRE and registry team.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused -> requires manual override. To override, please provide PR link and canary smoke pass logs.

meera: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/platform/PR-9987 - pins webimage to v1.23 in manifest and adds rollback rationale. Starting canary job now (ci-bot job #7824).

ci-bot: canary job 7824 started -> smoke tests running (headless render, healthchecks). ETA ~8m.

ana: Tagging @release-manager for approval flow once canary passes.

release-manager: Acknowledged. Hold release notes until we confirm canary. If canary passes before 11:00, we will manually approve and proceed with release. If not, we will move the window to next available slot and escalate.

ci-bot: canary job 7824 completed -> all smoke checks passed. Artifacts and logs: https://ci.internal/7824/logs

deploy-bot: Manual override available. To proceed, run `/deploybot override promo-id 2026-03-22-1100 --pr=PR-9987` and confirm in this thread.

luke: I ran the override command and it returned success. Promo resumed.

ana: Promo resumed and green in staging. I'll update the release notes draft with the pin and follow-up ticket INF-2999 to track mirror integrity and registry multipart uploads.

release-manager: Thanks. Closing hold. Please follow up on INF-2999 and link the investigation to the release postmortem.

meera: Following up with registry team to surface upload telemetry. Will post updates in INF-2999.

ana: Marking this thread resolved; moving to post-release follow-up. :white_check_mark:
